environment.cpu: Intel Core i9-11900KF (8 cores, 16 threads), CPU E-steps use all hardware threads
environment.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 (8 GiB), driver 590.48.01, subgroup 32, shader float64
environment.display: Xephyr :7 (nested X server), 64x64 window, VSync off, validation layers off

outcomes.round_trip: GRAPHICS150LowLatencyCompute (CPD E-step workspace, 4096 x 3000): framed 3.0 frames / 8.92 ms, immediate 0.0 frames / 3.36 ms per round trip, identical readback bytes
outcomes.rigid_1000_points: Vulkan 34.2 ms (was 78.4 ms framed) vs CPU twin 28.0 ms: still 1.22x slower; 16 of 25 iterations on the device, 1.4 ms per iteration
outcomes.rigid_10000_points: Vulkan 349 ms (was 399 ms) vs CPU twin 1315 ms (3.8x); 19 of 35 on the device
outcomes.rigid_100000_points: Vulkan 20.1 s (was 19.8 s) vs CPU twin 186.5 s (9.3x): compute-bound, latency irrelevant
outcomes.parity: max registered-point delta to the CPU twin 2.5e-11 (10^5), 1.6e-12 (10^3); RMS to the ground truth equal

limitations: The broker's pump still runs once per engine frame, so each device iteration waits for the next frame's job drain; at 10^3 points (1 ms CPU E-step) that pacing keeps the device path 22% behind the CPU. With VSync on (sandbox) a frame is 16 ms, so small inputs lose more there. One host, one GPU, one rigid fixture.
not_measured: VSync-on pacing; nonrigid and Bayesian device runs; ICP (QueueGpuNearest batches stay framed).
